category_edits.rationale: Add a bounded causal repeat feature across all four datasets: scale each nonpadding input embedding by 1 + 0.1 * min(log1p(c), log(4)) / log(4), where c counts earlier occurrences within the available input prefix. Embedding parameters, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so inference automatically uses the identical feature with one checkpoint per dataset.
